novel_features.name: Grant audit (effective access)
novel_features.description: Expand a workbook, connection, workspace, or dataset's grants into the full effective member list and flag org-wide or public access.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a local join across grants, teams, and members that no single Sigma API call returns.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when answering 'who can actually see this resource?' — it resolves team grants down to people, which the raw API leaves to you.
novel_features.group: Governance you can't get from one API call

novel_features.name: Workbook copy with ownership repair
novel_features.description: Copy a workbook and automatically reassign ownership to the intended recipient instead of the calling admin.
novel_features.rationale: Bundles the documented copy-then-PATCH-inode ownership fix into one safe command; the raw API silently leaves the copy owned by the caller.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this instead of the raw copy endpoint whenever the new workbook should belong to someone other than the API service account.

novel_features.name: Stale-workbook detection
novel_features.description: List workbooks untouched for more than N days, joined to their owner and folder path.
novel_features.rationale: A local-data threshold over synced workbooks; the API has no 'untouched in N days' filter.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this during content cleanup or governance reviews to find abandoned workbooks and who owns them.
novel_features.group: Governance you can't get from one API call

novel_features.name: Member offboard with content reassign
novel_features.description: Deactivate a member and reassign every workbook and file they own to another member in one command.
novel_features.rationale: Combines deactivation with a local owned-content index and per-inode ownership reassignment that the API requires you to orchestrate yourself.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when someone leaves so their content doesn't become orphaned — the single biggest admin offboarding gap.

novel_features.name: Bulk member provisioning
novel_features.description: Create or update members in bulk from a CSV, assigning teams and user attributes idempotently in one pass.
novel_features.rationale: Loops the member-create, team-assign, and user-attribute endpoints idempotently; it is the only programmatic provisioning path for orgs without Enterprise+SAML SCIM.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this for Monday onboarding batches when SCIM isn't available and clicking through the UI per-person isn't viable.

novel_features.name: Member access review
novel_features.description: Show everything one member can reach across workbooks, connections, and workspaces via direct and team grants.
novel_features.rationale: A reverse local join from member to teams to grants to resources that no single API call provides.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to verify a deactivated member lost access, or to answer a security question about one person's reach.
novel_features.group: Governance you can't get from one API call

novel_features.name: Bulk export by search
novel_features.description: Resolve a set of workbooks by offline name/path search and export them all to CSV, PDF, or XLSX in one invocation.
novel_features.rationale: Combines offline FTS over synced workbook names and paths with a loop over the export endpoint across every match.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this for recurring stakeholder exports where you want every workbook matching a name pattern, not one at a time.

narrative.headline: The first full-featured CLI for the Sigma Computing API, plus a local mirror, offline search, and governance audits no other Sigma tool has.
narrative.value_prop: Every Sigma REST resource as a composable command with --json and a local SQLite store. On top of the raw API it adds governance and provisioning commands the platform forces you to hand-roll: grant audit resolves team grants down to people, member offboard reassigns a leaver's content instead of orphaning it, member provision bulk-onboards from a CSV, and workbook copy fixes the documented ownership bug automatically.
narrative.auth_narrative: Sigma uses OAuth2 client-credentials. Create an API client under Administration > Developer Access to get a client ID and secret. Run 'auth login' to store them, or set SIGMA_COMPUTING_CLIENT_ID, SIGMA_COMPUTING_CLIENT_SECRET, and SIGMA_COMPUTING_BASE_URL (your org's API base URL, also under Developer Access). The CLI exchanges these for a ~1-hour bearer token and refreshes it automatically.

quickstart.comment: Confirm credentials and base URL resolve and the token exchange works.
List workbooks to confirm read access and see the resource shape.
Mirror workbooks, members, teams, connections, and grants into the local store for offline search and audits.
First governance payoff: find abandoned workbooks and their owners.

troubleshoots.fix: Verify SIGMA_CLIENT_ID and SIGMA_CLIENT_SECRET, and that SIGMA_BASE_URL matches your org's API base URL under Administration > Developer Access (it is per-cloud and cannot be guessed).
A materialization schedule must have run successfully at least once before a manual run works; create and let the schedule run first.

troubleshoots.symptom: Copied workbook is owned by the wrong person
troubleshoots.fix: Use 'workbook copy --to <member>' which auto-reassigns ownership, instead of the raw copy endpoint.

troubleshoots.symptom: List command seems to return only some rows
troubleshoots.fix: List endpoints are cursor-paginated; the CLI follows nextPage automatically on 'sync' and list commands — use 'sync' for the complete set.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for Sigma administration and BI delivery automation: bulk member onboarding/offboarding, grant and access audits, stale-content cleanup, workbook copy/export pipelines, and connection/data-model management. It is the right tool when you need scriptable, --json output for CI or governance reviews rather than clicking through the Sigma web UI, and especially when SCIM provisioning is unavailable.
